6.3.1.v: In the following sūtras up to विभाषा स्वसृपत्योः [[6.3.24]], inclusive, is always to be supplied the phrase 'the elision does not take place before the second member of the compound'.

6.3.2.v: The Ablative -5th case-ending after स्तोक etc. is not elided before the second member of a compound.

6.3.3.v: The Instrumental -3rd case endings after 1. ओजस् 2. सहस् 3. अम्भस् and 4. तमस् are not elided before the second member of a compound.

6.3.4.v: After मनस् when the compound is a Name, the Instrumental -3rd case endings are not elided before the second member.

6.3.5.v: Also before आज्ञायिन् the Instrumental -3rd case endings of मनस् are not elided.

6.3.6.v: The Instrumental -3rd case endings after आत्मान् are not elided when an Ordinal Numeral follows.

6.3.7.v: The Dative -4th Case ending is not elided after आत्मान् when the compound is the name of a technical term in grammar.

6.3.8.v: The Dative -4th Case endings is not elided after पर when the compound is the name of a technical term in grammar.

6.3.9.v: The Locative -7th case ending is not elided after a stem ending in a consonant or a short अ when the compound is a Name.

6.3.10.v: The Locative -7th case affix is not elided after a stem ending in a consonant or a short अ in the name of atax of the Eastern People when the second member begins with a consonant.

6.3.11.v: The Locative -7th case-affix is not elided after मध्य when गुरु follows.

6.3.12.v: is not elided after a word denoting a part of the body (with the exception of मूर्धन् and मस्तक) before every word other than काम।

6.3.13.v: The Locative -7th case-affix is optionally not elided after a word ending in a consonant or अ before बन्ध।

6.3.14.v: In a तत्-पुरुष समास when the second member is a word formed with a कृत् affix the Locative -7th case ending is optionally preserved.

6.3.15.v: The Locative -7th case-affix ending is retained after 1. प्रावट् 2. काल and 3. दिव् when ज follows.

6.3.16.v: The Locative -7th case-affix ending is optionally retained after 1. वर्ष 2. क्षर 3. शर and 4. वर when ज follows.

6.3.17.v: The Locative -7th case-affix ending is optionally retained after a word denoting time ending in a consonant or अ when तरप् or तमप् or the word काल or the affix तन follow.

6.3.18.v: The Locative -7th case-affix ending is optionally retained after the words 1. शय 2. वास and 3. वासिन् when the preceding word does not denote time and ends in a consonant or a short अ।

6.3.19.v: The Locative -7th case ending is not preserved before a stem ending in इन् before he word सिद्ध and before a word derived from बन्ध् ।

6.3.20.v: The Locative -7th case ending is not preserved before स्थ in the spoken language.

6.3.21.v: The Genitive 6th-Case-affix is retained when the compound expresses an 'affront or insult'.

6.3.22.v: The Genitive 6th-Case-affix is optionally retained when insult is meant when पुत्र follows.

6.3.23.v: The Genitive 6th-Case-affix is retained after a word ending in ऋ and expressing a relationship through study or blood.

6.3.24.v: The Genitive 6th-Case-affix is optionally elided after a stem ending in ऋ when 1. स्वसृ and 2. पितृ follow.

6.3.25.v: In a द्वन्द समास of words ending in the short ऋ and expressing relationship through study or blood, the आनङ् is the substitute of ऋ of the first member.

6.3.26.v: The आनङ् is the substitute for the final of the first member in a द्वन्द समास of the names of the देवता-s.

6.3.27.v: For the final of अग्नि is substituted the long ई when 1. सोम or 2. वरुण follow.

6.3.28.v: The short इ is the substitute of the final of the अग्नि in such a द्वन्द समास in which both the members take the वृद्धि।

6.3.29.v: For दिव् is substituted द्यावा in a द्वन्द समास of names of देवता-s.

6.3.30.v: For दिव् is also substituted दिवस् (as well as a द्यावा) when पृथिवी follows in a द्वन्द समास of names of देवता-s.

6.3.31.v: For उषस् is substituted उषासा in a देवता - द्वन्द समास।

6.3.32.v: According to Northern Grammarians मातरपितरौ is a valid form.

6.3.33.v: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the form पितरामातरा is a valid form.

6.3.34.v: In the room of a feminine word there is substituted an equivalent and uniform masculine form when it is a word which has an actual corresponding masculine and does not end in the feminine affix ऊङ् and is followed by another feminine word in the relation of apposition with it, but not when such subsequent word is an ordinal numeral, nor प्रिय etc.

6.3.35.v: A feminine word not ending in the affix ऊङ् and having an equivalent and uniform masculine is changed into such masculine form, before the affixes beginning with तसिल् etc. -- पञ्चम्यास्तसिल् [[5.3.7]], and ending with कृत्वसुच् -- संख्यायाः क्रियाऽभ्यावृत्तिगणने कृत्वसुच् [[5.4.17]].

6.3.36.v: A feminine word not ending in ऊङ् and having an equivalent and uniform masculine is changed into masculine before the Denominative कयङ् and the affix मानिन्।

6.3.37.v: A feminine word having a penultimate क् does not assume the masculine form.

6.3.38.v: The feminine is not changed to masculine when it is a Name or an Ordinal Numeral.

6.3.39.v: The feminine is not changed into masculine when it is formed by such a तद्धित affix which causes the वृद्धि of the first syllable with exception however of तद्धित-substitute meaning 'coloured therewith' and 'made thereof'.

6.3.40.v: A feminine in ई ending in the name of a part of body does not become masculine except the word मानिन् follows.

6.3.41.v: A feminine noun expressing a class of kind does not become masculine.

6.3.42.v: The feminine (unless it ends in ऊ) having an equivalent and uniform masculine becomes masculine in a कर्मधारय समास and before 1. जातीय and 2. देशीय।

6.3.43.v: Before the affixes 1. तर 2. तम 3. रूप 4. कल्प 5. चेल (with the feminine affix ई) 6. ब्रुव 7. गोत्र 8 मत and 9. हत a word ending in the feminine affix ङी becomes short when the feminine consists of two or more syllables and has an equivalent and uniform masculine.

6.3.44.v: In all the remaining feminine words called नदी -- यू स्त्र्याख्यौ नदी [[1.4.3]] and नेयङुवङ्स्थानावस्त्री [[1.4.4]], the substitution of short vowel under the preceding circumstances is optional.

6.3.45.v: The feminine ङी (ई) added to a word formed by a तद्धित affix having an indicatory उ or ऋ is optionally shortened before the घ etc. -- घरूपकल्पचेलड्ब्रुवगोत्रमतहतेषु ङ्योऽनेकाचो ह्रस्वः [[6.3.43]].

6.3.46.v: For the final महत् of is substituted आत् (आ) before a word which is in apposition with it and before जातीय।

6.3.47.v: आत् (आ) is substituted for the final of द्वि and अष्टन् when another numeral follows but not in a बहुव्रीहि समास or before आशीतिः।
6.3.47.e: The words द्वि and अष्टन् get an आकारादेश in presence of a  सङ्ख्याशब्द, provided that there is no बहुव्रीहि समास and the word अशीति is not present.
6.3.47.sa: द्वि-शब्दस्य अष्टन्-शब्दस्य च सङ्ख्याशब्दे परे आकारादेशः भवति । परन्तु 'अशीतिः' शब्दस्य विषये, तथा च बहुव्रीहिसमासे अयमादेशः न भवति ।
6.3.47.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.3.48.v: For त्रि is substituted त्रयस् when another numeral follows but not in a बहुव्रीहि समास or before आशीतिः।
6.3.48.e: The words त्रि gets an आकारादेश in presence of a  सङ्ख्याशब्द, provided that there is no बहुव्रीहि समास and the word अशीति is not present.
6.3.48.sa: त्रि-शब्दस्य सङ्ख्याशब्दे परे त्रयस्-आदेशः भवति । परन्तु 'अशीतिः' शब्दस्य विषये, तथा च बहुव्रीहिसमासे अयमादेशः न भवति ।
6.3.48.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.3.49.v: The above substitution is the case of all (द्वि , त्रि and अष्टन्) is optional when the word चत्वारिंशत् and the numerals which follow it are the second member.

6.3.50.v: हृद् is substituted for हृदय before लेख and the affixes यत् and अण् and before लास।

6.3.51.v: हृद् is optionally substituted for हृदय before the words शोक and रोग or the affix ष्यङ् follow.

6.3.52.v: पद् is substituted for पाद before 1. आजि 2. आति 3. ग and 4. उपहत।

6.3.53.v: पद् is substituted for पाद before the affix यत् used in any sense other than that of 'suited there to'.

6.3.54.v: पद् is substituted for पाद before 1. हिम 2. काषिन् and 3. हति।

6.3.55.v: पद् is substituted for पाद before the affix शस् when the meaning is that of a ऋक् (Hymn).

6.3.56.v: पद् is optionally substituted for पाद before 1. घोष 2. मिश्र and 3. शब्द।

6.3.57.v: उद is substituted for उदक when the compound is a Name.

6.3.58.v: उद is substituted for उदक before 1. पेषं 2. वास 3. वाह and 4. धि।

6.3.59.v: उद is optionally substituted for उदक before a word beginning with a single consonant and which expresses that which is filled with water.

6.3.60.v: उद is optionally substituted for उदक before 1. मन्थ 2. ओदन 3. सक्तु 4. बिन्दु 5. वज्र 5. भार 6. हार 7. वीवध and 8. गाह।

6.3.61.v: According to the opinion of गालव a short vowel is substituted in a compound before the second member for the long इक् vowels (ई , ऊ , ॠ) unless it is the long vowel of the feminine affix ई (ङी).

6.3.62.v: The short is substituted for the long एका before a तद्धित affix and when a second member follows.

6.3.63.v: The short is diversely substituted for the feminine affixes ई and आ (ङी and आप्) in a Name and in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

6.3.64.v: The feminine affixes ई and आ (ङी and आप्) diversely become short before the affix त्व।

6.3.65.v: For the long vowel a short is substituted in इष्टका before चित in इषीका before तूल and in माला before भारिन्।

6.3.66.v: A short is always substituted for the final of the first member when the second member is a word formed by an affix having an indicatory ख but not when the first member is an indeclinable.

6.3.67.v: मुम् is the augment added immediately after the final vowel of अरुस , द्विषत् and of a stem ending in a vowel unless it is an indeclinable, when the word formed by a खित् affix follows.

6.3.68.v: A monosyllabic word ending in any vowel other than अ when followed by a word formed by a खित् affix receives the augment अम् which is added in the same way as the affix अम् of the Accusative -2nd case singular.

6.3.69.v: वाचंयम and पुरंदर are irregularly formed.

6.3.70.v: मुम् is the augment of सत्य and अगद when the word कार follows.

6.3.71.v: मुम् is the augment of the words श्येन and तिल before पात when the affix ञ् follows.

6.3.72.v: The word रात्रि optionally takes मुम् augment before a word formed by कृत् affix.

6.3.73.v: The न of the Negative Particle नञ् is elided when it is the first member of a compound.

6.3.74.v: After the above न-elided of the Negative Particle नञ् (i.e. after अ) is added the augment नुट् to a word beginning with a vowel.

6.3.75.v: The Negative Particle remains unchanged in - 1. नभ्राज् 2. नपात् 3. नवेदस् 4. नासत्या (dual) 5. नमुचि 6. नकुल 7. नख 8. नपुंसक 9. नक्षत्र 10. नक्र and 11. नाक।

6.3.76.v: The Negative Particle remains unchanged in a word which begins with एक and of this एक there is the augment अदुक् (अद्)।

6.3.77.v: The Negative Particle is optionally retained unchanged in नगो when it does not mean a living animate being.

6.3.78.v: स is substituted for सह , in a Name.

6.3.79.v: स is substituted for सह when it has the sense of 'up to the end'.

6.3.80.v: स is substituted for सह when it is in connection with a word which refers to a second object which latter however is not directly perceived.

6.3.81.v: स is substituted for सह in an अव्ययीभाव समास when the second member is not a word denoting time.

6.3.82.v: स is optionally substituted for सह when the compound is a बहुव्रीहि समास।

6.3.83.v: The word सह retains its original form when the sentence denotes benediction, except when it is गो , वत्स or हल।

6.3.84.v: स is substituted for समान् in the छन्दस् (Vedas), but not before 1. मूर्धन् 2. प्रभृति and 3. उदर्क।

6.3.85.v: This substitution of स for समान् takes place before 1. ज्योतिस् 2. जनपद 3. रात्रि 4. गोत्र 5. रूप 6. स्थान 7. वर्ण 8. वयस् 9. वचन and 10. बन्धु in the common language also.

6.3.86.v: स is substituted for समान् before ब्रह्मचारिन् when it denotes persons engaged in fulfilling a common vow of studying the Vedas.

6.3.87.v: स is substituted for समान् before तीर्थ when the affix यत् is added to it.

6.3.88.v: स is optionally substituted for समान् before उदर when the affix यत् is added to it.

6.3.89.v: स is substituted for समान् before 1. दृग् 2. दृश and the affix वत्।

6.3.90.v: ई is substituted for इदम् and की for किम् before the words 1. दृग् 2. दृश and the affix वत्।

6.3.91.v: आ is substituted for the final of the pronouns - सर्वादीनि सर्वनामानि [[1.1.27]], before the words 1. दृग् 2. दृश and the affix वत्।

6.3.92.v: In the room of the last consonant that follows it, of a pronoun and of the words विषवक् and देव is substituted अद्रि when अञ्च् with the affix व follows.

6.3.93.v: समि is substituted for सम् before this अञ्च् when no affix (or व affix) follows.
6.3.93.e: If the 'सम्' उपसर्ग is followed by an लुप्तप्रत्ययान्त-अञ्च् word, then 'सम्'  is converted to 'समि'.
6.3.93.sa: 'सम्' उपसर्गात् परं यदि 'अञ्च्' धातोः लुप्तप्रत्ययान्तरूपमागच्छति, तर्हि 'सम्' इत्यस्य 'समि' इति आदेशः भवति ।
6.3.93.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.3.94.v: तिरि is substituted for तिरस् before this अञ्च् when no affix (or व affix) follows, provided that the अ of अञ्च् is not elided.
6.3.94.e: If the word 'तिरस्' is followed by a  लुप्तप्रत्ययान्त-अञ्च् word from which an अकार has not been removed, then the word 'तिरस्' is converted to 'तिरि'.
6.3.94.sa: 'तिरस्' इत्यस्मात् परं यदि 'अञ्च्' धातोः अलुप्त-अकारात्मकं लुप्तप्रत्ययान्तं च रूपमागच्छति, तर्हि 'तिरस्' इत्यस्य 'तिरि' इति आदेशः भवति ।
6.3.94.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.3.95.v: सघ्रि is the substitute of सह before अञ्च् when no affix (or व affix) follows.
6.3.95.e: If the word 'सह' is followed by an लुप्तप्रत्ययान्त-अञ्च् word, then 'सह'  is converted to 'सध्रि'.
6.3.95.sa: 'सह' शब्दात्  परं यदि 'अञ्च्' धातोः लुप्तप्रत्ययान्तरूपमागच्छति, तर्हि 'सह' इत्यस्य 'सध्रि' इति आदेशः भवति ।
6.3.95.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.3.96.v: सध is substituted for सह in the छन्दस् (Vedas) when माद and स्थ follow.

6.3.97.v: After 1. द्वि 2. अन्तर and prepositions, long ई is the substitute of अप्।

6.3.98.v: After अनु , ऊ is substituted for (the अ of) अप् when the sense is that of a locality.

6.3.99.v: अन्य when not used in the Genitive 6th-Case or the Instrumental -3rd case gets the augment दुक् (द्) before 1. आशिस् 2. आशा 3. आस्था 4. उत्सुक 5. कारक and 6. राग as well as before the affix छ (ईय).

6.3.100.v: दुक् (द्) is optionally the augment of अन्य when अर्थ follows.

6.3.101.v: कत् is substituted for कु in a तत्-पुरुष समास when a word beginning with a vowel follows as the second member.

6.3.102.v: कत् is substituted for कु before रथ and वद।

6.3.103.v: कत् is substituted for कु when तृण follows denoting a species.

6.3.104.v: का is the substitute of कु before पथिन् and अक्ष।

6.3.105.v: का is the substitute of कु when the meaning is 'a small'.

6.3.106.v: का is optionally the substitute of कु when the word पुरुष follows.

6.3.107.v: का and कवङ् are optionally the substitutes of कु when उष्ण follows.

6.3.108.v: This substitution of का and कव for कु takes place in the छन्दस् (Vedas) before पथ।

6.3.109.v: The elision, augment and mutation of letters to be seen in पृषोदर etc. though not found taught in the treatises of Grammar, are valid to that extent and in the mode, as taught by the usage of the sages.

6.3.110.v: अहन् may optionally be substituted for अह्न in the Locative -7th case singular when a numeral or वि or साय precede it.
6.3.110.e: When the word अह्न appears as an उत्तरपद in a समास where the पूर्वपद is either a number, or the words वि or साय, it is optionally converted to अहन् in presence of the प्रत्यय ङि.
6.3.110.sa: संख्यावाचीशब्दात् परस्य , 'वि'शब्दात् परस्य, तथा 'साय'शब्दात् परस्य 'अह्न' शब्दस्य ङि-प्रत्यये परे विकल्पेन 'अहन्' आदेशः भवति ।
6.3.110.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.3.111.v: When ढ् or र् is elided for the preceding अ , इ and उ a corresponding long vowel is substituted.
6.3.111.e: When a ढकार is deleted due to a ढकार that follows it, or when a रेफ is deleted due to a रेफ that follows the अण् letter occurring before the deleted ढकार/रेफ becomes दीर्घ.
6.3.111.sa: ढलोपनिमित्तके ढकारे परे ढकारलोपे कृते , रलोपनिमित्तके रेफे परे रलोपे कृते वा,  तस्मात् पूर्वस्य अण्-वर्णस्य दीर्घः भवति ।
6.3.111.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.3.112.v: When ढ् or र् are elided, there is the substitution of ओ or आ of the verbs सह् and वह्।
6.3.112.e: For the verbs सह् and वह्, when a ढकार is deleted due to a ढकार that follows it,  the अकार occurring before the deleted ढकार is converted to ओ.
6.3.112.sa: ढकारलोपनिमित्तके ढकारे परे  सह्-धातोः वह्-धातोः च अवर्णस्य ओकारादेशः भवति ।
6.3.112.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.3.113.v: 1. साढ्यै 2. साढ्वा and 3. साढा are irregularly formed in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

6.3.114.v: In the following sūtras up to the end of the पाद are to be supplied the words 'in an uninterrupted flow of speech'.

6.3.115.v: Before कर्ण there is the substitution of a long vowel for the final of the preceding word when it denotes a proprietorship mark or the ears of cattle, but not when the words 1. विष्ट 2. अष्टन् 3. पञ्चन् 4. मणि 5. भिन्न 6. छिन्न 7. छिद्र 8. स्रुव and 9. स्वस्तिक।

6.3.116.v: A long vowel is substituted for the final vowel of the preceding word, before the verbs 1. नह् 2. वृत् 3. वृष् 4. व्यध् 5. रुच् 6. सह् and 7. तन् when these roots take the affix क्वि।

6.3.117.v: For the final vowel of कोटर etc. a long vowel is substituted before वन and also of किंशुलक etc. before गिरि when the compound is a name.

6.3.118.v: The final of the preceding word is lengthened before the affix वल।

6.3.119.v: The final vowel of a word consisting of more than two syllables in lengthened before the affix मत् when it is a name, but not of the words अजिर् etc.

6.3.120.v: The final vowel of शर etc. is lengthened before मत् when it is a name.

6.3.121.v: The final इ and the उ of a word with the exception of पीलु are lengthened before वह।

6.3.122.v: The final vowel of a preposition is diversely lengthened before a word formed by the कृत् affix घञ् but not when the compound denotes a human being.

6.3.123.v: A preposition ending in इ or उ lengthens its final before काश।

6.3.124.v: A preposition ending in इ or उ lengthens its final before the verb दा when the latter is changed to त।

6.3.125.v: A long vowel is substituted for the final of अष्टन् before a second member, when the compound is a Name.

6.3.126.v: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) also, the long vowel is substituted for the final of अष्टन् before a second member.

6.3.127.v: The final word of चिति is lengthened before the affix कप्।

6.3.128.v: The final vowel of विश्व is lengthened before वसु and राट् (the form assumed by राज्).

6.3.129.v: The final vowel of विश्व is lengthened before नर when the compound is a Name.

6.3.130.v: The final vowel of विश्व is lengthened before मित्र when it is the name of a ऋषि।

6.3.131.v: In a मन्त्र the final vowels of 1. सोम 2. अश्व 3. इन्द्रिय and 4. विश्वदेव्य are lengthened when the affix मतुप् follows.

6.3.132.v: In a मन्त्र the final of ओषधि is lengthened before the case-endings but not in the Nominative 1st-Case.

6.3.133.v: In the ऋग्वेद the finals of the particles 1. तु 2. नु 3. घ 4. मक्षु , the tense-affix तङ् , कु the ending त्र and the word उरुष्य are lengthened.

6.3.134.v: In a मन्त्र the finals of the preceding member ending in इ or उ are lengthened before the particle सु।

6.3.135.v: A tense affix ending in अ is lengthened in the ऋग्वेद when the verb consists of two syllables.

6.3.136.v: In the ऋग्वेद the final of a particle is lengthened.

6.3.137.v: The elongation of the final is to be found in other words also.

6.3.138.v: The final vowel of the preceding member is lengthened before अञ्च when it assumes the form च having lost its nasal and the vowel.
6.3.138.e: When the अञ्च् word is in a state where its अकार and नकार have been removed, it causes the दीर्घ of the previous अण् letter.
6.3.138.sa: लुप्त-अकार-नकारे अञ्च्-शब्दे परे पूर्वस्य अण्-वर्णस्य दीर्घादेशः भवति ।
6.3.138.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

6.3.139.v: The vowel substituted for a semi-vowel is lengthened when it stands as the first member of a compound.
